This is WDSU-AM New Orleans. The temperature is 34 degrees in New Orleans right now. Low tonight, cold, 30 to 34 degrees. Hello, racing fans. This is Chuck Pratt speaking, and it'll be my pleasure to be with you each racing night with the complete results from the fairgrounds. It's the 97th season for the historic fairgrounds, and they invite you to join me each racing night at 6.15 p.m. on WDSU radio. I'll have highlights of the day plus Pratt's peachy pit. It's a lot of fun, so follow the local Oval activity…
